notes.title: Production Update 2
notes.notes:
Good news! Production of all the levels has been completed. All levels including their respective 

puzzles are up and running from start to finish. The game is now in its final stages of development

which include final polishing, adding more assets to fill out the environment, lighting adjustments 

and fine tuning AI and story-beat elements. It has been a long journey but the finish line is on the

horizon! Stay tuned for further updates as Project Fiend get closer to release!

notes.title: PRODUCTION UPDATE
notes.notes:
The first four levels of the game have been completed (minus the final polish) and 

fully playable! New diverse locations to explore and more exciting puzzles to solve!

Although there are more levels in development, production is going smoother could

have been anticipated and I look forward to bringing Project Fiend closer to completion.

Thank you for your continued support and patience!
